results.title: Karnataka Parks Bill Row: Govt To Revisit 5% Parkland Rule After Lalbagh Protests | News18
results.description: The controversy over Karnataka’s Parks Amendment Bill has intensified after widespread protests by Bengaluru citizens, environmental activists, park walkers and Opposition leaders. Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar has now said the government will revisit the controversial provision and discuss the issue again in the legislature.The amendment to the Karnataka Government Parks (Preservation) Act allows up to 5% of the total area of a park to be alienated through mechanisms including sale, lease or other means for specified public utility and infrastructure projects. The provision has triggered concerns over the future of Bengaluru’s green spaces and the possible impact on iconic locations such as Lalbagh and Cubbon Park.Thousands of Bengaluru residents recently participated in protests at Lalbagh, opposing both the park-land amendment and concerns surrounding the proposed tunnel road project.
